description: Second round of NaN-keeping forms against r6k: indexer bits (NaN tested on the float's bits) and fixup (r6k's loop plus a separate NaN loop), SwiGLU clamps as pure expressions; bits, time in three alternating rounds, and each variant's tests and NaN contracts.
argv: import os, subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_relu2.py'])]; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/b' + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', '')); RUNS = [('indexer=/b/indexer_isnan.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'), ('indexer=/b/indexer_bits.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'), ('indexer=/b/indexer_fixup.py', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'), ('activation=/b/activation_fixed.py', '', 'tests/kernels/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_activation.py'), ('activation=/b/activation_expr.py', '', 'tests/kernels/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_activation.py')]; codes += [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'swap_plugin', '-rfEPxX', *(['-k', k] if k else []), path], env=dict(env, SWAP=swap)) for swap, k, path in RUNS]; print('exit codes (bench, indexer isnan, bits, fixup, swiglu fixed, expr)', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
